Modifications: selected and linked official register entries to existing FR/ES/IT rows; corrected only type, type_local and level. No endorsement by source institutions. Evidence: .github/fixes-docs/ledgers/types_eu3_v5x.jsonl and sibling .sources.json; exact retrieval dates, archive editions and SHA-256 retained. Ambiguous identities held unchanged.

methods.FR: Own literal current P374 and P31 select one COG COM/COMD/COMA/ARM entry; exact normalized row/register/own names, same department, own point within 10 km; COM also inside a hash-verified official commune polygon and no extinction. Row and official names must both be attested on the literal own item; historic aliases may bridge a current name without renaming the row. COMD/COMA P576 can describe former full commune status, current delegated/associated own P31 plus COG entry must independently agree. Existing nonnull parent must agree. No former commune is relabelled as its successor.
methods.ES: Own literal P772 selects exactly one current municipio, singular or nucleus (municipal total aliases collapse to municipio). Own municipio P31 or subtype required for municipio; municipio class conflicts with settlement. Row and official names both attested on the own item (including INE article forms and historic aliases), province, IGN containing municipio, own point and independently coded own P131 municipio for localities. Multiple singular/nucleus codes remain held, no scope guessed.
methods.IT: Own current P635 plus comune P31 chooses current comune even if main locality has same name. Centro requires exact name in census localities, settlement/frazione own P31 without current/former comune class or ISTAT-code conflict, independently coded own P131 item that is itself a current nonextinct comune in the same province, valid exact census polygon containing unchanged row point, and own point corroboration. No former legal unit is silently converted to its successor or its main locality. 2021 localities whose own parent cannot be tied directly to the current register remain held; no inferred crosswalk.
methods.unresolved: Latest identity outcome from baseline plus first-parent-ordered events. Changed unresolved keys require identical v4 name, own item, point, province/state/country and register-bound present entity; reviewed decision_only event cites this compact ledger SHA-256. All v4 rows retained in inputs.
methods.scope: 873 targets from pinned master: FR city without type_local plus adm3; ES city and section without type_local; IT city without type_local plus adm3. Compact ledger includes changed rows and register-bound holds only. Every target, including unbound holds, is in review.jsonl and CSV partitions. No populations changed.
methods.normalization: Full accent/case/punctuation folding; apostrophes removed; explicit bilingual slash names and INE postposed articles only. No substring or fuzzy matches.

fields.pc: direct own P131 current comune codes
fields.ps: direct own parent statement index sources

archive_note: Full own Wikidata HTTP archives dated 9-20 October 2026; corroborated by freshly fetched explicit literal-item P374/P772/P635/P31/P625/P576 indexes dated this run. Conflicting current codes, scope or points held. Directly named parent codes come from the same fresh index. Raw bytes copied to work/sources. Fresh COG, INE national archives and ISTAT current comuni retrieved in this run. Full review and point tests in work/review.jsonl. Exact locality polygons use original census-2021 code; current code changes not inferred.
